title: Moonlit Breakwater: The Historian's Harbor Charter
premise: In a drowned port exposed at the edge of the lunar tide, the historian must recover lost testimony without rewriting it using a chronicle decoding slate.
ending: Recover the Harbor Charter and return with the unaltered historical account; Night Harbor Guild can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive undertow gate while evading the lighthouse revenant without sacrificing the unaltered historical account.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Night Harbor Guild to witness the chronicle decoding slate.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal a compromising record
